messages:
liam-eng: starting quantized bring-up for goliath-70k (int2+fp8). short run shows misaligned KV slots when prefill hits exact shard boundary. anyone seen wrapping artifacts like this?

maria-ml: could be the RoPE scaling order in the quant path. if we apply rotary after packing, index math can differ when window_base % shard_size == 0.

liam-eng: repro: `./run_prefill --model goliath-70k --quant int2_fp8 --prefill 8192 --streaming 4608 --shard 4096 --dump /tmp/kvd.npz`

kvcache-bot: checksum: FAIL slot=12288 expected=0x2b1c got=0x2b2c (detected during stitch).

anya-qa: quick manual test: reduce prefill by 1 token -> checksum passes. that smells like an off-by-one wrap.

maria-ml: two quick tries: 1) run with `--apply-rope-before-quant` 2) enable boundary clamp in stitcher util. please try both and report stats over 20 runs.

liam-eng: ran 20 runs baseline -> 14/20 failures. with rope-before-quant -> 3/20 failures. with clamp enabled -> 0/20 failures.

anya-qa: i'll open a small PR to add clamp + an assertion `index_map.length == seq_len`. will run 1k smoke on CI if you approve.

maria-ml: thanks. i'll also start a kernel bisect to see where quant reorder introduced this. good short-term mitigation.

liam-eng: PR link when ready and tagging this thread. will hold canary until QA green.
